meta.name: launch-linkedin-campaign
meta.description: Set up a LinkedIn outreach campaign on a list of leads (connect → DM1 → DM2 sequence) by chaining `campaign:create` and `campaign:create-sequence`. Enforces the outbound hypothesis gate (refuses to launch without a hypothesis recorded for outreach-campaign-builder). Use when the user says 'launch a LinkedIn campaign for these leads', 'send a LinkedIn outreach to this list', 'start the outbound to the qualified leads', 'run the LinkedIn sequence on this result set', or 'fire the connect-then-DM flow'. Side-effecting — writes to SQLite and stages the sequence on Unipile.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动对潜在客户执行领英联系与私信序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要批量向领英联系人发送个性化消息序列。
copy.tagline_en: Automate LinkedIn outreach with connect-then-DM sequences for leads.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send personalized LinkedIn message sequences to a list of leads.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能根据你提供的线索列表，依次自动创建LinkedIn外展活动并草拟连接→第一条私信→第二条私信序列。它会先检查是否已录入了外展假设（没有则拒绝执行），然后收集活动标题、线索来源等必要信息，执行两个命令完成创建和序列草拟，最后询问你是否发送——不会自动发送。
howto.when: 当你说“launch a LinkedIn campaign for these leads”、“send a LinkedIn outreach to this list”、“start the outbound to the qualified leads”等类似指令时触发。
